descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S06 Deleting one Hospital patient: gone from the database at once, audit trail kept, and a same-name re-add starts empty

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of their data immediately (backups per OAT-04), and the audit log is kept. (TFA-94699 AC 4; UAT TC-24 Expected 5; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden … (UAT OAT-04; UAT OAT-04 step 2; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-92568 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • T8 Every delete asks for confirmation once and there is no bulk delete. Tested in TC-24 (U7-U9); here only: each patient or resident delete in S06 / S28 asks exactly once. (TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician (make-session fixture) with the Hospital patient {hospitalPatient} and a second Hospital control patient {hospitalControl}

When The agent adds the Important Point 'QA marker 7741' and saves BP 131/77 on {hospitalPatient}, removes that patient with its 'Remove ... from the rounding list' control and accepts the confirmation once, adds a new patient with exactly the same name through Add Patient (Age 70, Room 'QA-1', Diagnosis 'QA re-add test') …

Then The confirmation is asked exactly once; the Hospital list shows {hospitalControl} but not the deleted patient; the chart document and its list row are absent from the database right away; the audit log still holds every row written for that patient plus one op=delete row; the re-added chart has a new id and shows neither 'QA marker 7741' nor '131/77'; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 4 (hard delete, immediately), TFA-92568 AC 2, TC-24 Expected 5 and OAT-04 step 2 ('real deletion (queryable as gone), not a UI hide'): the verdict comes from the post-run backend reads (document gone, not flagged; list row gone; audit rows kept; new id; no row with the marker), never from list absence alone. …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S06

Deleting one Hospital patient: gone from the database at once, audit trail kept, and a same-name re-add starts empty

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane probes: status passed in probes/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): Scripted probe: add Important Point 'QA marker 7741' + BP 131/77, remove from the list (count confirms), first admin read: document null, roundingPatientList row gone, audit rows before kept + one op=delete; re-add same name through the form, new id, chart without marker/BP; scan every data table for the marker (run window). — permission-delete/dialog are page.on('dialog'); backend-read-admin is a read-only admin-key system query on the local stack.

Detail:

One confirmation ('Remove … from the rounding list? This will delete all notes, vitals, and encounter data…'); at the first admin read (83 ms after the list updated) the chart document is null and its roundingPatientList row is gone; every audit row written before the delete is kept plus exactly one op=delete; the same-name re-add has a new id and shows neither 'QA marker 7741' nor '131/77'; no row in roundingPatients/List, snfResidents/List, audit_logs, patientActivityEvents, aiCallLog, unassignedRoundingItems, handoffs holds the marker.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The verdict needs the deleted patient's audit_logs rows (backend-read-admin, the local admin key) and the same-name re-add needs permission-add-patient; dev has no admin key and no dev case adds a patient (runner-contract §10.3), so this stays on the local stack (once permission-add-patient and b…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
